hypotheses.title: Config drift disabled response caching and overloaded the database
hypotheses.summary: An automated config sync flipped response_cache_enabled to false at 22:10; database read QPS tripled and product-listing latency spiked until the cache was re-enabled.
unknowns: Why a staging-only config edit propagated to production
validation_steps: Trace the config sync pipeline for the r512 revision
Confirm the cache hit ratio dropped to zero at 22:10

impact_claims.description: Product listing p99 latency reached 5 seconds during the incident

remediation_items.description: Gate production config changes behind review and add config drift detection

hypotheses.title: An organic traffic surge overloaded the database
hypotheses.summary: The database read QPS rose well above baseline, which an unrelated traffic surge could explain independently of the cache flag.
unknowns: Whether edge request volume actually rose at 22:10
validation_steps: Compare edge request volume against the database read QPS at 22:10

hypotheses.title: A code change regressed the caching layer

unknowns: Whether any background job altered cache behavior
validation_steps: Audit deploy and job history for the cache service around 22:10
